interpretation: No SQL runner failures or gold misses occurred. This benchmark supplies curated structured query parameters and does not measure natural-language parsing.

latent_risks_not_scored_as_failures.detail: Company matching only removes whitespace and case-folds; historical names and aliases are not resolved.
Raw '-' becomes normalized NULL, so numeric/date predicates intentionally cannot match those contracts.
Only explicit/high links are searchable; inferred, ambiguous, unresolved and out-of-corpus predecessors remain unlinked.
Question text is documentation; the runner executes the reviewed structured query object. Agent intent parsing remains unevaluated.
Recall@k is question-level relevant-hit recall, matching the original evaluator, not set coverage of every receipt in broad multi-result questions.
